messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — prefilling OOM spike on gpu-serving-prod-east. Affected pods restarting. Severity: P2
ryan-oncall: looking. seeing repeated SIGKILL on runtime-prep containers, cause: OOM during prefill for long-context requests
sasha: customer Flowful reported timeouts, confirmed 5xx spikes around 00:12 UTC
ryan-oncall: check logs, posting stack snippet
miguel-eng: ```
2026-03-16T00:12:02Z runtime[pid=1123]: PrefillAlloc: allocate 6.1GiB failed: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
container restart: exit code 137
``` 
sasha: examples show ~40k token prompts hitting prefill path
tina-sre: immediate mitigations: 1) set per-tenant max_prefill_tokens=8k for hosted tier 2) enable aggressive kvcache eviction for node pool 'hotpool-east' 3) route Flowful to fallback model 'rwd-7b-compact'
ryan-oncall: doing 1 & 2 now
miguel-eng: patch ready to flip: --prefill-token-throttle=8000, --kvcache-eviction=aggressive. Will push to canary first
ryan-oncall: canary applied to 2 pods. monitoring
support-julie: prepping customer message. Flowful SL team already on the line. Any ETA window?
carla-product: high priority — need to avoid data loss. If we throttle, responses will be truncated; pls include in comms
miguel-eng: rolling canary rollout command:
```bash
kubectl -n rwd-runtime set env deployment/serving-runtime PREFILL_TOKEN_THROTTLE=8000
kubectl -n rwd-runtime patch deployment/serving-runtime -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"KVCACHE_EVICTION","value":"aggressive"}]}]}}}}'
```
ryan-oncall: canary looks stable for 12m, no restarts on those pods
tina-sre: promoting to 50% of hotpool-east, enable routing fallback for tenant Flowful -> rwd-7b-compact
support-julie: sending update to Flowful: short note that we're throttling unusually large prefills and routing to a compact fallback to restore service. ETA for full mitigation 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
miguel-eng: next step long-term: add prefix trimming heuristic and prefill-memory-estimator to reject requests with estimated peak > node capacity
ryan-oncall: creating incident doc & postmortem checklist. assigning follow-ups to miguel-eng (runtime patch), tina-sre (autoscaler tweaks), support-julie (customer comms)
incident-bot: Pager cleared — condition stabilized. Please update incident channel with final customer timeline when available. :thumbsup:
